source_excerpts.text:
## Strongest completed result

**The completed construction turns a hot passive quantum transport medium into a heralded logical link with an explicit error description that remains valid when the medium retains memory.** It avoids learning the medium’s unknown common two-mode orientation. An explicit endpoint circuit then turns that link into a **fresh Bell-pair service**, which a later recipient can consume through teleportation.

The theoretical result survives the comparisons. The complete operational result remains conditional: with the additional balance assumption and supplied endpoint noise model, the constructed service has a **conditional Bell half-trace-distance bound of 1.3435%** and an **acceptance probability of at least 0.52645 per attempt**. It misses a 1% target. The source observations do not establish the required endpoint control accuracy.

I recovered the saved proofs, numerical results, resource ledger and internal reviews. The results below are the completed investigation’s results; this recovery did not rerun the experiments or add a new independent review.

## 1. The operation and its central mechanism

A physical carrier consists of two fermionic modes containing one particle:

\[
|0\rangle=|10\rangle,\qquad |1\rangle=|01\rangle.
\]

Four such carriers pass through the medium. Each use has the **same fixed \(2\times2\) transfer block \(T\)**. Define its worst capture defect by

\[
\delta=1-\lambda_{\min}(TT^\dagger).
\]

The medium’s bath may be hot, non-Gaussian, correlated and retained between calls. Its coupling to a current carrier must still be a state-independent passive linear transformation. That is a substantive structural assumption.

The logical qubit uses the two-dimensional four-carrier singlet subspace, with basis

\[
\begin{aligned}
|0_L\rangle&=
\frac{|0101\rangle-|0110\rangle-|1001\rangle+|1010\rangle}{2},\\
|1_L\rangle&=
\frac{|0011\rangle+|1100\rangle
-\tfrac12(|0101\rangle+|0110\rangle+|1001\rangle+|1010\rangle)}
{\sqrt3}.
\end{aligned}
\]

Writing its encoding isometry as \(V\), the key identity is

\[
T^{\otimes4}V=(\det T)^2V.
\]

Thus a common unknown orientation contributes only a scalar on the code. Four-qubit reference-frame-free encoding is established machinery; the candidate contribution here is the explicit retained-bath error bound, acquisition connection and finite endpoint construction. Originality

7. Remaining gaps and boundaries of the theorem

The most consequential remaining gap is endpoint quality and cost. Further suppression of the native transport term would presently make only a small change to the complete delivered bound.

Other binding limitations are:

Common orientation is essential. Perfect capture alone is insufficient. A saved counterexample has

Source acquisition and source production have different independence requirements. The production checker does not automatically establish fresh-label isolation for calibration.
Timing and records define the instrument. Current internal check records and control keys are averaged after correction, and timing is padded. Publishing them is a stronger target.
Reuse requires stationarity. The counts do not establish indefinite stability or arbitrary changes in the native word.
The complete construction misses 1%. The generic branch also misses 2%. These are limitations of the current sufficient schedule, not impossibility results.
The outer consumer lacks a complete noisy endpoint compilation. No fault-tolerant computing threshold or scalable computing architecture was established.
Hardware feasibility, external acceptance and priority remain open. The stronger controls and distributed source infrastructure are real changes to the architecture.
